title.narrative: Boosting civic resilience and connectivity in the EaP

description.narrative:
This Action seeks to build a better connected and more resilient civil society across the Eastern Partnership region ¿ one that is ready and able to participate in the democratisation, reform and recovery processes in their countries, thus fostering more inclusive, resilient and democratic societies (Overall Objective). To achieve this objective, the Action will have the following three outcomes:

¿ Outcome 1: Civil society has increased capacity to reinforce their role in democratisation, reform and recovery processes. CSOs with increased resilience to internal and external shocks and pressure.

¿ Outcome 2: Civil society is more engaged with one another nationally and inter-regionally, and has the space to share experience, processes and ideas.

¿ Outcome 3: Civil society is better able to engage and communicate outside their bubbles by improving engagement with existing and new audiences, and in official policy processes.
